compatibility_policy.behavior: Supported versions must still pass dependency installation, tests, Chromium launch, AI/API contract, and Dashboard build.

notes: Python 3.12 + Node 22 remains the recommended and primary release baseline.
CI also exercises Python 3.13/3.14 dependency and test compatibility, plus Windows Python 3.14 + Node 24.
pandas 2.3.3 is pinned because it publishes CPython 3.14 wheels, unlike the previous pandas 2.2.3 pin.
Dashboard dependencies are reproduced by dashboard/package-lock.json and npm ci.
